text: A wholesale package-manager grant reaches that manager's own env-runner: Bash(pnpm *) reaches 'pnpm dlx' and 'pnpm exec', and the npm and yarn grants reach 'npm exec' and 'yarn dlx' the same way. Wildcards span arguments and env-runners are not stripped before matching (spec-facts), so excluding the bare 'npx *' narrows a spelling and not the capability. Flag patterns are not the fix — the next flag spelling walks past them. The decision is whether a <lang>-dev profile may grant a package manager wholesale at all, which trades a silent env-runner against a prompt on every install.
source: codex adversarial review of v0.6.0..HEAD, 2026-09-03; the pnpm half predates 0.1.x
